adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#remove_member the diff changes member removal to `group.users.delete(user_id)` (no longer using the prior `group.remove(user)` logic that existed in the removed `update_patch` path). Association `delete` removes the join row directly and will bypass any custom bookkeeping in `Group#remove` / join-model callbacks (e.g., updating a cached `user_count`). The subsequent `group.save` in this method does not recompute membership counts. Since `user_count` is serialized in admin group listings (BasicGroupSerializer output includes `user_count` per the spec) and is used in the admin UI for paging math (`totalPages` in admin-group.js.es6), a stale counter would produce incorrect displays/pagination until recomputed elsewhere.
